supported_scope: Headless runs accept --print-timeout as a maximum wait for a response; useG1Credits controls whether personal AI credits are used once plan quota is exhausted.
required_setup: Pass --print-timeout in headless mode; set useG1Credits off to restrict fallback billing.
constraints: Documentation conflict on the headless timeout default: the headless page says five minutes; CLI changelog v1.2.6 says the default changed to unlimited

evidence.quote: set it to off to restrict fallback billing

evidence.section: Antigravity CLI > Session-scoped Remote Control, unlimited headless run timeouts, structured error reporting, and artifact text selection
evidence.quote: Changed the default timeout for headless ( -p / --prompt ) runs from 5 minutes to unlimited
